name: Anatomy
tagline: Interactive 3D human anatomy explorer built with Three.js + GPT 5.6
description: An interactive 3D human anatomy explorer that combines Three.js rendering with GPT 5.6 for rich, on-demand explanations. You can orbit, zoom, and dissect the human body while the model answers questions about each structure. Written in TypeScript, it hit 2.1k stars in just 8 days.
highlights: Full 3D human anatomy explorer in Three.js
Orbit, zoom, and dissect the body interactively
curatorNote: A fast-rising fusion of 3D rendering and LLM interactivity — a strong template for interactive educational apps.
